help.connectivity.body: Managing your digital connections is straightforward via the built-in Settings panel. mariowOS provides native interfaces for managing Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Ethernet networks instantly.
help.connectivity.mirrors.body: Updates are securely fetched from verified mariowOS remote mirrors.
help.connectivity.mirrors.title: Secure Mirrors:
help.connectivity.modular.body: Because of the system's modular nature, many updates apply instantly without requiring a full system reboot.
help.connectivity.modular.title: Modular Upgrades:
help.connectivity.newer.body: The updater compares versions semantically, so it only ever offers a build that is genuinely newer than the one you are running.
help.connectivity.newer.title: Newer Builds Only:
help.connectivity.updater.body: Keeping your system secure and equipped with the latest features is handled entirely by the built-in Updater application.
help.connectivity.updater.title: The Updater
help.intro.body: mariowOS is a revolutionary, modular, and lightweight web-based desktop environment. Designed from the ground up for speed, minimalism, and high contrast, it provides a seamless user experience that feels both familiar and fundamentally modern.
help.intro.performance.body: By leveraging modern web technologies and keeping the core system extraordinarily light, mariowOS ensures instant boot times and snappy application responses, even on lower-end hardware.
help.intro.performance.title: Built for Performance
help.intro.title: Welcome to mariowOS
help.lab.body: For power users, developers, and early adopters, mariowOS includes a dedicated space known as the Functions Lab, accessible via the System Settings.
help.lab.caution.body: Features contained within the Functions Lab are actively in development. While exciting, enabling them may cause unexpected behavior or temporary system instability. Use these features primarily for testing and development purposes.
help.lab.caution.title: Proceed with Caution
help.lab.toggle: The Functions Lab is where you can toggle experimental tools, advanced developer features, and beta API access for your workspace.
help.personalization.accents.body: Buttons, toggles, and highlights automatically adjust to complement your background.
help.personalization.accents.title: System-wide Accents:
help.personalization.body: Making mariowOS your own is incredibly straightforward. Head over to the Wallpaper & Style or Lockscreen settings to adjust your desktop's visual footprint.
help.personalization.contrast.body: The engine ensures that text remains highly legible by calculating appropriate contrast ratios on the fly.
help.personalization.contrast.title: Smart Contrast:
help.personalization.monet.body: At the heart of the UI customization is the custom-built monet-engine. When you change your wallpaper, this engine dynamically extracts an optimized color palette from the image.
help.personalization.monet.title: Powered by monet-engine
help.security.auth.body: Sensitive actions—such as modifying network configurations, resetting the system, or granting elevated app permissions—will always trigger a mandatory secure password prompt. The system will not proceed without verifying your identity.
help.security.auth.title: Mandatory Authentication
help.security.body: At the core of mariowOS is a profound commitment to your privacy and security. The system architecture is designed to prevent unauthorized access by default.
help.security.sandbox.body: mariowOS utilizes strict process sandboxing. There is a hard separation between user applications and the system core. Applications run in isolated environments; they cannot read or write to sensitive system files or access data from other apps without your explicit permission.
help.security.sandbox.title: Strict Process Sandboxing
help.sidebar.title: Help
help.ui.body: The interface is built with highly responsive layouts that seamlessly adapt to your workflow, whether you are on a desktop monitor or a portable touch device.
help.ui.workers.body: Unlike traditional operating systems that can hang when a single app misbehaves, mariowOS guarantees complete system stability. Intensive tasks and heavy computations are automatically offloaded to background worker threads.
help.ui.workers.callout: This asynchronous architecture guarantees that the main user interface never freezes. You can continue interacting with the desktop while complex tasks run silently in the background.
help.ui.workers.title: Background Worker Threads

GNU nano keyboard help

Ctrl+O  WriteOut (save)
Ctrl+X  Exit
Ctrl+W  Search forward
Ctrl+R  Insert a file
Ctrl+K  Cut line or selection
Ctrl+U  Uncut
Ctrl+Y/V Previous/next page
Ctrl+C  Show cursor position
Ctrl+J  Reflow current paragraph
Ctrl+T  Spell check (not available)

Press Ctrl+G again or Escape to return.
